What is Corpogn?

CorpoGN is an online platform that aids firms, NGOs, public sectors, and departments of the government in managing all social welfare projects from one single point of operation. The platform allows for easy planning of the project, coordination with the NGO, budgeting, monitoring, measuring the outcome, and even generating all reports that would be required for any kind of compliance. Using this platform means you no longer have to use various platforms and spreadsheets in order to manage your CSR initiatives.

Our CSR Services

CSR Governance & Compliance

Make sure that all corporate social responsibility initiatives are kept well organized, manageable, and easy to track. Approvals, actions, project adherence to government regulations, and reports can all be done in a single place.

View Details

CSR Project & Fund Management

Coordinate and administer CSR initiatives from beginning to end, all in one platform. Collaborate with your NGO partners, monitor your project budget and expenditures, track the status of every project, and get updates using easy-to-use dashboards.

View Details

NGO Partner Management

Identify and collaborate with reliable NGO partners much faster. Create new NGO accounts, view all information about them, store all related documents in one place, manage their activities, and always stay in contact with them.

View Details

Impact Measurement & ESG Reporting

Evaluate the impact that your corporate social responsibility initiatives are having. Identify the stakeholders who have been helped, assess the progress that has been made by the initiative, evaluate whether the initiative is meeting its objectives, and prepare clear reports about this information.
